name: Manual Boosting (gradient on residuals)
when_to_use: Continuous dependent variable; illustrates the boosting principle (sequential fitting of residuals) before using ready-made gbm/xgboost.

expected_input.question: How to improve prediction by sequentially fitting residuals?

plain_explanation.purpose: Builds a model in stages, each one correcting the errors of the previous.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you want to understand in practice how boosting works, before using a library.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A table with the response and factor columns.
plain_explanation.example: Improve step by step the default forecast, correcting the badly predicted cases.
plain_explanation.diagram: model 1 -> errors -> model 2 focuses on the errors -> model 3 ...
